message.content:
**Kill Visual Studio Code (code.exe) from the command line**

```cmd
:: Find the process ID(s) of VS Code (optional)
tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq code.exe"

:: Kill all running instances of VS Code immediately
taskkill /IM code.exe /F
```

* `/IM code.exe` – matches the image name (`code.exe`).  
* `/F` – forces termination (equivalent to “End Process” in Task Manager).

If you prefer to target a specific instance, first get its PID:

```cmd
tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq code.exe"
```

Then kill it by PID:

```cmd
taskkill /PID <PID_NUMBER> /F
```

---

### Quick PowerShell alternative

```powershell
Stop-Process -Name code -Force
```

Both methods work on Windows 10/11 and later. If you’re running into “Access denied”, run the command prompt or PowerShell as **Administrator**.
